Roll-up summaries are off by default. They are aggregate weekly/monthly/yearly files (`%@`) generated from HealthKit daily snapshots and are not daily records. Each enabled period processes its complete touched calendar windows, so a yearly summary can read hundreds of source days even when the final files are small. Turn on Summary files only to skip daily files and write just the enabled summaries.
